name: callback
description: Authorized tool for escalating the conversation to a human call. It must be called when the flow cannot resolve something on its own (no availability, the booking fails repeatedly, a piece of information remains ambiguous, or the user explicitly asks to speak with a person). It only validates and normalizes the request — it does not send any email or create any task; the actual notification mechanism is executed by a subsequent step in the flow.
notes: MANDATORY EXECUTION TRIGGER: if the active flow node is C__CB_RUN, execute this tool immediately — execution on this node is mandatory, without exception. Also execute it when get_available_slots returns no availability after several attempts, when book_appointment fails repeatedly, when a piece of information remains ambiguous after retrying, or when the user explicitly asks to speak with a person.
ARGUMENT RULE: contact_name is always required. You must send at least one of contact_phone and contact_email — you do not need to send both, but do not send neither.
ARGUMENT RULE: reason must be one of the 5 exact values listed below — map the actual flow situation to the closest one; do not invent another value.

ARGUMENT RULE: if the user mentions a preferred day, send it in preferred_days — accepts one day, multiple days separated by commas, or shortcuts such as 'weekdays'/'weekend'. If the user mentions a time range, map it to morning/midday/afternoon/evening in preferred_time_window. Neither is mandatory — if the user did not provide a preference, do not send them (or send 'any').

ARGUMENT RULE: iana_timezone is required and must be the same IANA timezone already determined for the user (the same one you would use for get_available_slots) — do not ask for it again if you already have it.
SOURCE OF TRUTH RULE: use 'errors' as the sole indicator that the request is incomplete or malformed — if it is null, the request is ready for the flow to escalate.

POST-EXECUTION RULE: after a successful execution (errors is null), inform the user that someone will contact them and close that branch of the conversation warmly — do not continue trying to resolve yourself what prompted the callback.

POST-EXECUTION RULE: if errors is not null, the data indicated in the message is missing or invalid — collect or correct it with the user and call the tool again before considering the request complete.

inputs.name: contact_name
inputs.description: Full name of the contact as mentioned during the call.

inputs.name: contact_phone
inputs.description: Contact's phone number in international format. At least one of contact_phone and contact_email must be provided. e.g. +573001234567

inputs.name: contact_email
inputs.description: Contact's email address. At least one of contact_phone and contact_email must be provided. e.g. maria@example.com

inputs.name: reason
inputs.description: Callback reason. One of: no_availability (no availability was found), booking_failed (the booking failed repeatedly), user_requested (the user asked to speak with a person), ambiguous_data (a piece of information remained ambiguous after several attempts), technical_error (technical error during the flow).

inputs.name: context
inputs.description: Short summary of what happened in the conversation, so the person calling does not do so blindly. e.g. 'No availability was found in the next 14 days'

inputs.name: preferred_days
inputs.description: Day or days when the user prefers to be called. Accepts one day, multiple days separated by commas, a list, or the shortcuts 'weekdays' / 'weekend' / 'any' (no preference). e.g. 'weekdays', 'monday,wednesday'

inputs.name: preferred_time_window
inputs.description: Time window when the user prefers to be called. One of: morning, midday, afternoon, evening, any.

inputs.name: iana_timezone
inputs.description: Standard IANA timezone identifier for the user — the same one already determined for get_available_slots. Examples: 'America/Bogota', 'America/Sao_Paulo', 'Europe/Madrid', 'Asia/Tokyo'.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Boolean value indicating whether the tool executed successfully.

outputs.name: contact_name
outputs.description: Echo of the received name. null if the request was rejected.

outputs.name: contact_phone
outputs.description: Echo of the received phone number.

outputs.name: contact_email
outputs.description: Echo of the received email address.

outputs.name: reason
outputs.description: Normalized echo of the reason (lowercase).

outputs.name: context
outputs.description: Echo of the received context.

outputs.name: preferred_days
outputs.description: Normalized list of days (Monday through Sunday, in that order), with shortcuts already expanded. Empty array ([]) if no preference was provided or 'any' was provided.

outputs.name: preferred_time_window
outputs.description: Normalized echo of the time window. null if no preference was provided or 'any' was provided.

outputs.name: iana_timezone
outputs.description: Echo of the received timezone.

outputs.name: errors
outputs.description: Explains why the request was rejected (missing or invalid data: contact_name, contact_phone/contact_email, reason, iana_timezone, preferred_days, or preferred_time_window). null when the request is ready to be escalated.

name: end_call
description: Closes the call session in an orderly way.
notes: This is always the last tool executed in any terminal flow.
Make sure all required updates have been completed before end_call.

name: time_now
description: Authorized tool for getting the real current date and time in the given timezone. Its response is the flow's only authorized time reference.
notes: MANDATORY EXECUTION TRIGGER: when a node declares EXECUTE: time_now, call it as the first action of the turn — imperative, no exception.

ABSOLUTE EXECUTION RULE: FORBIDDEN to deduce, estimate, or assume the current date or time from the model's knowledge, training, or conversational context. Do not speak or route before capturing the 'now' field.
ARGUMENT RULE: iana_timezone is an IANA continent/city identifier (e.g. America/Bogota, Europe/Madrid, America/Sao_Paulo). Send whatever the flow fixes; never use abbreviations (EST, COT, BRT).
SOURCE OF TRUTH RULE: use the 'now' field as the only authorized time reference. To normalize a relative date ('8 months ago', 'last year'), compute it from 'now'.
POST-EXECUTION RULE: if 'now' comes back null or 'errors' is not null, call the tool again before continuing.

inputs.name: iana_timezone
inputs.description: IANA identifier of the timezone the current time is wanted in (continent/city). Examples: America/Bogota, Europe/Madrid, America/Sao_Paulo.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Boolean: the query ran successfully.

outputs.name: iana_timezone
outputs.description: Echo of the IANA timezone identifier used.

outputs.name: now
outputs.description: Current date and time in the given timezone, ISO 8601 with offset. Example: 2026-08-28T18:18:28.935329-05:00. null on error.

outputs.name: errors
outputs.description: Error message if the query failed. null on success.

name: check_visa
description: Revisa si una o varias nacionalidades requieren visa para ingresar a Colombia como turista.
notes: MANDATORY EXECUTION TRIGGER: ejecútala cuando el contacto mencione su nacionalidad o pregunte si necesita visa para viajar a Colombia.
ARGUMENT RULE: nationalities puede ser un string separado por comas ('USA, China') o una lista de strings (['USA', 'China']). Soporta nombres comunes o códigos ISO 3166-1 alfa-3.

SOURCE OF TRUTH RULE: usa nationality, requires_visa y conditional_visa (no un array) para decidir el resultado de la consulta. Revisa conditional_visa para casos como China o India donde se requiere visa a menos que tengan visa USA/Schengen.

inputs.name: nationalities
inputs.description: Una o más nacionalidades a revisar. Ejemplos: 'USA', 'China, India', ['Spain', 'AFG'].

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Valor booleano que indica si la herramienta se ejecutó correctamente.

outputs.name: nationality
outputs.description: Nombre de la(s) nacionalidad(es) revisada(s), limpia de espacios.

outputs.name: requires_visa
outputs.description: Indica si la persona requiere visa para entrar a Colombia (bool).

outputs.name: conditional_visa
outputs.description: Indica si el requisito está condicionado a visa USA/Schengen (bool).

outputs.name: summary
outputs.description: Resumen legible de los requisitos encontrados.

outputs.name: errors
outputs.description: Mensaje de error técnico si la consulta falló. null en caso de éxito.

name: get_available_slots
description: Authorized availability tool for Family Aims commercial appointments (IVF or Surrogacy). Its output is the only authorized source of days and times.
notes: MANDATORY EXECUTION TRIGGER: on entering node SC__SC_AV_I (use calendar_type: 'IVF') or SC__SC_AV_S (use calendar_type: 'SUR'), call get_available_slots as the first action of the turn — imperative, no exception. Also on any intent to schedule, reschedule, see more options, or retry an appointment.
ABSOLUTE EXECUTION RULE: do not mention days, dates, times, or availability, and do not route, before executing the tool and capturing a valid response.

ARGUMENT RULE: iana_timezone is a real IANA timezone identifier (continent/city, or continent/country/city for zones that need it, e.g. America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires), already resolved in the flow from the contact's country and city (Colombia -> America/Bogota). Never guess it, never shorten a three-part identifier to two parts, and never use abbreviations such as EST or COT.
ARGUMENT RULE: calendar_type must be 'IVF' or 'SUR' depending on the flow node where the contact is located.

SOURCE OF TRUTH RULE: the only source of times is the available_slots array from the most recent call. A time is valid only if it appears as an object with start_co, end_co, start_local, and end_local. If errors is not null or available_slots is not a valid list, treat the response as invalid.
PRESENTATION RULE: when speaking with the contact use only start_local/end_local. start_co/end_co are Colombia time (the calendar's zone), for internal use only.

POST-EXECUTION RULE: if the contact asks for more options, move within the same array before calling the tool again. When booking, copy start_co of the chosen slot into start_date of book_appointment without altering the offset.

inputs.name: calendar_type
inputs.description: Literal defining the calendar to use: 'IVF' for in vitro fertilization or 'SUR' for surrogacy. Determined by the flow node where the contact is located.

inputs.name: iana_timezone
inputs.description: Real IANA identifier of the contact's current timezone (continent/city, or continent/country/city for zones that need it). Examples: America/Bogota, Europe/Madrid, America/New_York, America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires. Resolved from the contact's country and city before executing — never guessed, never shortened to two parts when the real identifier has three.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Boolean: the query ran correctly. It does not by itself indicate whether there is availability — check available_slots for that.

outputs.name: iana_timezone
outputs.description: Echo of the real IANA identifier (continent/city, or continent/country/city) used to compute start_local/end_local.

outputs.name: available_slots
outputs.description: Array of objects with the available slots. Each object carries start_co/end_co (Colombia time, ISO 8601) and start_local/end_local (contact's zone, ISO 8601). Empty array ([]) if there is no availability.

outputs.name: errors
outputs.description: Error message if the query failed. null on success, even when available_slots came back empty.

name: book_appointment
description: Authorized booking tool for Family Aims commercial appointments (IVF or Surrogacy). Creates the appointment from a valid get_available_slots slot.
notes: MANDATORY EXECUTION TRIGGER: on entering node SC__SC_BOOK_I (use calendar_type: 'IVF') or SC__SC_BOOK_S (use calendar_type: 'SUR'), call book_appointment as the first action of the turn — imperative, no exception. Never call it without having executed get_available_slots first.
ABSOLUTE EXECUTION RULE: do not say the appointment is scheduled, booked, or confirmed, and do not route to confirmation, before receiving success == true and a non-null event_id.

ARGUMENT RULE: start_date is copied literally from the start_co field of the chosen slot — do not convert, round, reformat, or infer it. duration is fixed: <APPOINTMENT_DURATION_MINUTES>. language is 'EN', 'ES', or 'PT', taken from [preferred_language] (the active conversation language). iana_timezone is the same IANA zone used in get_available_slots. contact_name, contact_email, and contact_phone come from the value already confirmed in the flow.
ARGUMENT RULE: calendar_type must be 'IVF' or 'SUR' depending on the calendar where the booking is being made.
SOURCE OF TRUTH RULE: use success as the only authorized result to decide whether the appointment was created.

POST-EXECUTION RULE: if success is false, check reason: 'past_date' or 'invalid_start_date' -> return to get_available_slots; 'invalid_hour' -> tell the contact it is outside business hours and offer to check again; 'creation_failed' or missing reason -> system problem, apologize and route to a callback.

inputs.name: calendar_type
inputs.description: Literal defining the calendar where the booking will be made: 'IVF' for in vitro fertilization or 'SUR' for surrogacy.

inputs.name: start_date
inputs.description: Start date and time in ISO 8601 with offset. Literal copy of the start_co field of the chosen slot in available_slots. Example: 2026-06-04T08:00:00-05:00

inputs.name: duration
inputs.description: Appointment duration in minutes, sent as a string. Fixed value for this flow: <APPOINTMENT_DURATION_MINUTES>.

inputs.name: language
inputs.description: Two-letter uppercase language code, strictly 'EN', 'ES', or 'PT', for the confirmation and follow-up notifications. Selected from [preferred_language], the language in which the active conversation is being conducted.

inputs.name: contact_name
inputs.description: Contact's full name, already confirmed in the flow.

inputs.name: contact_email
inputs.description: Contact's email in lowercase, already confirmed in the flow. Used to send the appointment confirmation.

inputs.name: contact_phone
inputs.description: Contact's phone in E.164 international format, already confirmed in the flow. Example: +573001234567

inputs.name: iana_timezone
inputs.description: IANA identifier of the contact's timezone, the same one used to check availability in get_available_slots.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Boolean: the booking was created correctly.

outputs.name: reason
outputs.description: Reason for rejection when success is false: 'invalid_start_date', 'past_date', 'invalid_hour', 'invalid_email', 'creation_failed', 'slot_taken'. null when success is true.

outputs.name: event_id
outputs.description: Created event identifier. null if the booking was not completed.

outputs.name: event_link
outputs.description: Link to the event in the calendar. null if the booking was not completed.

outputs.name: meet_link
outputs.description: Video call link for the appointment. null if the booking was not completed.

outputs.name: errors
outputs.description: Technical error message. May be present with success == true if the appointment was created but the email notification failed.

name: find_appointment
description: Herramienta autorizada para buscar citas existentes de un contacto por su nombre o correo en los calendarios de Family Aims.
notes: MANDATORY EXECUTION TRIGGER: ejecútala cuando el contacto quiera consultar, verificar o conocer los detalles de una cita que ya cree haber agendado.
ARGUMENT RULE: contact_name debe ser el nombre completo del contacto tal como figura en el CRM o como se registró en la cita.
ARGUMENT RULE: contact_email es el correo electrónico del contacto. Úsalo preferentemente si el nombre es ambiguo o para mayor precisión.
ARGUMENT RULE: calendar_type permite filtrar por 'IVF' o 'SUR'. Debe coincidir con el tipo de proceso del contacto.
SOURCE OF TRUTH RULE: el array 'appointments' contiene la lista de citas encontradas. Si está vacío, informa al contacto que no se encontraron registros bajo ese nombre o correo.

inputs.name: contact_name
inputs.description: Nombre completo del contacto para realizar la búsqueda.

inputs.name: contact_email
inputs.description: Correo electrónico del contacto para realizar la búsqueda.

inputs.name: calendar_type
inputs.description: Filtro de calendario: 'IVF' o 'SUR'.

inputs.name: iana_timezone
inputs.description: Zona horaria IANA para mostrar las horas de las citas encontradas. Defecto: America/Bogota.

inputs.name: language
inputs.description: Idioma para formatear los resultados. Defecto: ES.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Booleano indicando si la búsqueda se completó.

outputs.name: appointments
outputs.description: Lista de objetos con información de las citas encontradas (event_id, summary, start_time, calendar_type).

outputs.name: errors
outputs.description: Mensaje de error si la búsqueda falló.

name: cancel_appointment
description: Herramienta autorizada para cancelar/eliminar una cita existente en los calendarios de Family Aims.
notes: MANDATORY EXECUTION TRIGGER: ejecútala únicamente cuando el contacto solicite explitamente cancelar su cita y proporcione o confirme el event_id (obtenido previamente vía find_appointment).
ABSOLUTE EXECUTION RULE: no confirmes la cancelación antes de recibir success == true.
ARGUMENT RULE: event_id debe ser el ID exacto devuelto por la API. calendar_type debe ser 'IVF' o 'SUR' según corresponda a la cita.

inputs.name: event_id
inputs.description: Identificador único del evento de Google Calendar a cancelar.

inputs.name: calendar_type
inputs.description: Tipo de calendario donde reside la cita: 'IVF' o 'SUR'.

inputs.name: iana_timezone
inputs.description: Zona horaria IANA del contacto.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Booleano indicando si la cancelación fue exitosa.

outputs.name: errors
outputs.description: Mensaje de error si la cancelación falló.

name: edit_appointment
description: Herramienta autorizada para modificar o reprogramar una cita existente en los calendarios de Family Aims.
notes: MANDATORY EXECUTION TRIGGER: ejecútala cuando el contacto solicite cambiar la fecha, hora o duración de una cita ya agendada.
ABSOLUTE EXECUTION RULE: no confirmes el cambio antes de recibir success == true.
ARGUMENT RULE: event_id debe ser el ID exacto de la cita. calendar_type debe ser 'IVF' o 'SUR'.
ARGUMENT RULE: new_start_date debe ser un slot válido obtenido de get_available_slots si se está reprogramando. Si solo se cambia la duración, este campo es opcional.
VALIDATION RULE: la herramienta verifica automáticamente disponibilidad y horario laboral antes de aplicar el cambio.

inputs.name: event_id
inputs.description: Identificador único del evento de Google Calendar a modificar.

inputs.name: calendar_type
inputs.description: Tipo de calendario: 'IVF' o 'SUR'.

inputs.name: new_start_date
inputs.description: Nueva fecha y hora en ISO 8601 con offset. Requerido si se cambia el horario.

inputs.name: new_duration
inputs.description: Nueva duración en minutos (como string). Requerido si se cambia la duración.

inputs.name: iana_timezone
inputs.description: Zona horaria IANA del contacto. Defecto: America/Bogota.

inputs.name: language
inputs.description: Idioma para la confirmación. Defecto: ES.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Booleano indicando si la modificación fue exitosa.

outputs.name: message
outputs.description: Mensaje de confirmación del cambio realizado.

outputs.name: new_start_time
outputs.description: Fecha y hora formateada si hubo cambio de horario.

outputs.name: errors
outputs.description: Mensaje de error si la modificación falló.
